commands.text:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --ignore-scripts
else
  npm install --ignore-scripts
fi

commands.step: Assert package version matches GitHub release tag
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
PKG="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
if [ "$PKG" != "$TAG" ]; then
  echo "::error::package.json version ($PKG) does not match release tag ($TAG)"
  exit 1
fi

set -euo pipefail
PKG="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
if [ "${RELEASE_PRERELEASE}" = "true" ] || [[ "$PKG" == *-* ]]; then
  npm publish --provenance --access public --tag next
else
  npm publish --provenance --access public
fi
